messages.subject: Project Quartz — draft term sheet for review
messages.plaintextBody:
Eleanor,

Attached is the draft non-binding term sheet reflecting your indicative terms: £1.5m upfront, 6.5% running royalty, minimum royalties stepping to £500k, exclusive in the compostable flexible-packaging field in Europe, and an exclusive negotiation period to 30 November. Only the exclusivity, confidentiality and costs sections are binding.

If you're happy we'll send it to Denham Lewis for Brandt.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Quartz — term sheet
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Thanks. Klaus is broadly comfortable. Two flags for the definitive docs: Brandt will want the territory expanded well beyond Europe (likely worldwide ex-North America), and the royalty looks high to them - expect a push down. Exclusivity section is fine to sign. Marcus Webb will run day-to-day with your Elena.

Adam
